SELECT feed.task_code, feed.arrange_code, feed.produce_task_code, MAX(task.mat_code) as productCode, MAX(task.mat_name) as productName, produceTask.route_code, MAX(produceTask.route_name) as route_name, feed.mat_code, feed.reservation_no, feed.requirement_mat_code, MAX(feed.substitute_flag) as substitute_flag, MAX(feed.substitute_ratio) as substitute_ratio, MAX(feed.mat_name) as mat_name, MAX(feed.mat_spec) as mat_spec, feed.mat_batch as batchNo, feed.warehouse_code, MAX(feed.warehouse_name) as warehouse_name, feed.site_code, MAX(feed.site_name) as site_name, MAX(feed.mat_unit) as mat_unit, MAX(feed.status) as status, (SUM(COALESCE(feed.feed_num, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(feed.used_num, 0))) as leftNum, MAX(feed.update_time) as lastUsedTime, MAX(feed.is_lock) as is_lock, MAX(feed.factory_code) as factory_code FROM mes_warehouse_feed feed LEFT JOIN mes_task task on feed.task_code = task.code AND feed.factory_code = task.factory_code AND task.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN mes_produce_task produceTask on feed.produce_task_code = produceTask.code AND feed.factory_code = produceTask.factory_code AND produceTask.del_flag = '0'
1 = 1 AND feed.del_flag = '0' AND feed.factory_code = #{query.factoryCode}
AND feed.task_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.taskCode}, '%')
AND feed.arrange_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.arrangeCode}, '%')
AND feed.produce_task_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.produceTaskCode}, '%')
AND task.mat_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productName}, '%')
AND feed.mat_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matCode}, '%')
AND feed.mat_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matName}, '%')
AND feed.mat_spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.matSpec}, '%')
AND feed.mat_batch LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchNo}, '%')
AND feed.site_code = #{query.siteCode}
GROUP BY feed.task_code, feed.arrange_code, feed.produce_task_code, produceTask.route_code, feed.mat_code, feed.mat_batch, feed.reservation_no, feed.requirement_mat_code, feed.warehouse_code, feed.site_code ORDER BY lastUsedTime DESC
